findings.summary: ROOT CAUSE (log+fix-commit pinned): the v1 write-scope guard ran CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain | cut -c4-) and rejected anything not matching ^evidence/run-memory/. Because the ENTIRE evidence/ tree was untracked at commit 7514921 (the directory did not yet exist on main), git status --porcelain collapsed all nested writes to the single entry '?? evidence/', so BAD='evidence/' and the job exited 1 even though every write was inside evidence/run-memory/. This is a FALSE POSITIVE of the scope-guard family: the gate blocked exactly the writes it was built to allow. Confirmed as a recognized mechanism by the later fix commit 30fc94f whose comment states it verbatim.

SCOPE-GATE PATTERN IS STILL LATENT IN FIVE OTHER CONTROL-PLANE WORKFLOWS (curator Git cross-check during this distillation): the identical unfixed construct `git status --porcelain | cut -c4-` remains in physics-loop.yml (3 sites), graph-loop.yml (3 sites), cto-council.yml (1), runtime-loop.yml (2) at current main; frontier-research.yml also consumes git status --porcelain. The fix 30fc94f touched ONLY evidence-curator.yml. Any lane/frontier session that creates a WHOLLY-NEW directory anywhere in the tree can reproduce this false-positive class there (known siblings from prior incidents: pre-staged control-plane files killed Physics #7 audit in run 32860596387; allowlist omissions killed Runtime #6 in run 32887030457).

Work-loss economics: a complete ~20-minute curation session (model opencode/x-preview-f-free; OpenCode 1.18.23; 7 deliverables written and schema-validated) was discarded at the persist gate, then the identical batch had to be re-curated from scratch by a later run (commit c191c64, ~1h34m after this run started). Net cost of the defect ~= one full duplicated curator session plus ~21 min runner time; zero bytes persisted by THIS run.

LOST-PASS CONTENT DISPOSITION: the stranded pass's final summary table and its 10 feed findings (CTO-2026-08-25-01..10) are visible verbatim in this log. Cross-check against current durable memory shows the MAIN results were re-created durably by c191c64 (all five target records exist with distilled=true; e.g. WP-006 FALSIFIED decomposition defects incl. openlibrary calibration 5/12 with 7 genuine state-drift failures and true corpus figure 62/74; Graph #5 empty-snapshot external_directory root cause; Graph #6 repair success with byte-identical scorer reproduction; Intel #1 SGDR REPRODUCED_USEFUL PoC hard@1 36/74 vs 25/74).
